stem: Candice would like to improve her concluding sentence by summing up the ideas she has presented. Which sentence should she use to replace sentence 35?

options.label: A
options.text: Finally, we must protect the Great Barrier Reef from being destroyed so future generations can enjoy it.

options.label: B
options.text: How much still remains to be discovered about the Great Barrier Reef of Australia is anybody's guess.

options.label: C
options.text: Researchers should explore the oceans further to try to find other natural wonders like the Great Barrier Reef.

options.label: D
options.text: Attracting visitors from around the world, the Great Barrier Reef has a beauty that is perhaps unequaled anywhere on Earth.
